item.title: Hear Together: Rockbridge Bull & Oyster Fest
item.description: Rockbridge Area Health Center is a nonprofit community health center in Lexington. The event features an afternoon of BBQ and oysters, craft brews and wine, live music from Gary Ruley and Mule Train, and more, in a tented outdoor venue overlooking Virginia’s Blue Ridge Mountains. item.title: Hear Together: BRIMS Presents Breabach
item.description: The Blue Ridge Irish Music School (BRIMS) is a nonprofit in Charlottesville dedicated to creating community through Irish music, dance and song, offering a range of classes for all ages and skill levels.On Sunday, April 12 at 7PM they will be presenting Scottish band Breabach at Potter's Craft Cider. Breabach's performances include pipes, fiddle, guitar, songs and stepdance, uniting deep roots in Highland and Island Gaelic tradition alongside progressive musical influences of their Glasgow base.

item.title: Hear Together: Parade of Playhouses
item.description: Rush Homes is a Lynchburg nonprofit working to develop affordable, accessible housing. They welcome you to join them for our 3rd annual Parade of Playhouses on Saturday, April 25 from 10AM-1PM at EC Glass High School. This event includes food, a foam party, face painting, a petting zoo, and more — even the opportunity to go home with a playhouse. item.description: Virginia native Bruce Hornsby's new album, Indigo Park, comes out on April 3rd. The title track is this week's Free Weekly Download at WNRN.org.
